'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a craftable quest item, by using various processed consumables, created through [[cooking]]. The recipe is unlocked while progressing through the [[Merchant]]'s quest-line. Despite being able to create various qualities, they're only useful by delivering '''5x'''{{Quality|gold}} to the Merchant upon request; they cannot otherwise be sold, consumed, or used in any way.

==Recipe==
The {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}} is a complex craftable, with a base increase of 30% towards quality chance. The required three items, roughly categorized into snacks, meals, and desserts, may impart additional bonuses of their own. These consumable items without any quality will not impart a bonus, while copper, silver, and gold qualities will increase the overall chance by a further 33%, 67%, or 100% respectively, per item.

==Tips & Tricks==
Including the base increase of 30%, a {{Quality|gold}}{{PAGENAME}} can be crafted at 97% chance utilizing one silver and two gold quality items. With this in mind:
*Choices in snacks are limited to {{Quality|silver}}/{{Quality|gold}} [[Onion rings]] and [[Toasts with onions]], or {{Quality|silver}} [[Pancakes]]
:{{*}}Pancakes would require the rare and expensive resource [[butter]].
:{{*}}The onion dishes simply require a silver or gold [[onion]]. (They are also remarkably cheap to buy)
*Choices in meals are vast, usually requiring a {{Quality|silver}}/{{Quality|gold}} vegetable or fish fillet.
:{{*}}The [[baked pumpkin]] or [[baked salmon]] are generally thought to be the easiest to obtain.
::{{*}}However, these do require the purchase of expensive recipes from [[Miss Chain]].
:{{*}}The [[burger]], while being the most complex, is the most likely to be readily available.
::{{*}}The recipe will be unlocked, it has a unique beneficial effect, and is also used during another quest-line.
::{{*}}It not only requires a high-quality [[onion]], but the energy-intensive [[bread]] and [[baked meat]] as well.

{{*}}[[Cabbage soup|Cabbage Soup]] is the easiest to make since Onions are used in Snacks and the other ingredients are easy to obtain

*Choices in desserts are limited to {{Quality|gold}} [[Cake]] or {{Quality|silver}}/{{Quality|gold}} [[Grape pie]].
:{{*}}Cake requires multiple ingredients, all of which are relatively inexpensive and easy to obtain.
:{{*}}Grape pie requires some silver or gold [[grapes]], likely already obtainable by this stage of the game.
In conclusion, to make a gold Dinner, it is recommended to use :  {{Quality|silver}} [[Toasts with onions]] -  {{Quality|gold}}[[Cabbage soup|Cabbage Soup]] - {{Quality|silver}} [[Grape pie]].<br>{{Navbox-Quest}}
